function: The <object> tag defines a container for an external resource.

attributes.name: data
attributes.function: Specifies the URL of the resource to be used by the object

attributes.name: form
attributes.function: Specifies which form the object belongs to

attributes.name: height
attributes.function: Specifies the height of the object

attributes.name: name
attributes.function: Specifies a name for the object

attributes.name: type
attributes.function: Specifies the media type of data specified in the data attribute

attributes.name: typemustmatch
attributes.function: Specifies whether the type attribute and the actual content of the resource must match to be displayed

attributes.name: usemap
attributes.function: Specifies the name of a client-side image map to be used with the object

attributes.name: width
attributes.function: Specifies the width of the object
